title: Prequential forecast-turnover stability and Top20 hit-count calibration

scorer_source.implementation: exact committed overlapCount, sonarTransitionProfile and sonarAnalogCore functions

hypothesis: The overlap between two consecutive prior-only APP SONAR Top20 forecasts may contain incremental information about the next target's Top20 hit count, beyond the exact Hypergeometric(40,20,5) null.

estimand.target: H_t = |S_t intersect D_t|, where S_t is the exact APP scorer Top20 computed from draws strictly before target t and D_t is target draw.
estimand.previous_forecast: S_(t-1) = Top20(sonarAnalogCore(draws[0:t-1])); both forecasts exist before D_t.

models.conditional: P_t(k|b)=(200*q0(k)+C_(t-1,b,k))/(200+N_(t-1,b)); counts include only prior evaluated targets in the same fixed stability bin.
models.tuning: None. Bins and shrinkage are fixed before Q117 calculations. Online counts update only after each target is scored.

endpoints: Log-loss of realized Top20 hit count

sign_flip.alternative: conditional model improves (mean baseline loss minus model loss > 0)

inference.multiple_testing: Holm correction across the two preregistered primary endpoints.

safeguards: Each target draw is excluded from both current and previous forecast prefixes.
No retrospective freeze reconstruction or target-dependent threshold selection.
The conditional probability for each target uses only outcomes from earlier targets.
Verify canonical archive chronology, unique dates, five distinct sorted integers in 1..40.
Verify exact APP source blob identity and deterministic replay.
Verify every probability vector sums to one within 1e-12.
Keep existing shadow freezes and Q60 gate unchanged.
limitations: Blind segment is historical and not a virgin holdout after prior SONAR exploration.
The online prequential model updates from earlier blind observations, but never from the current or future target.
Holm correction covers only the two Q117 primary endpoints, not the full historical SONAR experiment family.
This is a calibration diagnostic, not a claim that lottery outcomes are predictable.
decision_rule: No promotion. Retain only if blind OOS improvement is positive on both endpoints and statistically supported after Holm; otherwise record a null/negative result.
